title: "Penguin report"
format: html
---

## Data

```{r}
clean <- read.csv("data/processed/penguins_clean.csv")

# keep one species: filter out Adelie and Chinstrap
gentoo <- subset(clean, species == "Gentoo")
```

After removing incomplete rows, there are `{r} nrow(clean)` penguins in the data. `{r} nrow(gentoo)` of them are Gentoo penguins, which is the species we look at here.

## Results

The mean body mass of Gentoo penguins was `{r} round(mean(gentoo$body_mass))` g.

```{r}
aggregate(body_mass ~ sex, data = gentoo, FUN = mean)
```

```{r}
#| fig-alt: "Boxplot of Gentoo body mass, for females and males"
boxplot(body_mass ~ sex, data = gentoo, ylab = "Body mass (g)")
```
